{{Short description|Spanish mathematician}}
{{family name hatnote|Santos||lang=Spanish}}
'''Francisco "Paco" Santos Leal''' (born 28 May 1968) is a Spanish [[mathematician]] at the [[University of Cantabria]], known for finding a [[counterexample]] to the [[Hirsch conjecture]] in [[polyhedral combinatorics]].<ref name="Santos 2011 383–412">{{citation|last=Santos|first=Francisco
|title=A counterexample to the Hirsch conjecture
|journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] | volume=176 | issue=1 | pages=383–412|doi=10.4007/annals.2012.176.1.7 |mr=2925387
|year=2011|arxiv=1006.2814|s2cid=15325169
}}</ref><ref>{{citation|url=http://gaussianos.com/francisco-santos-encuentra-un-contraejemplo-que-refuta-la-conjetura-de-hirsch/|title=Francisco Santos encuentra un contraejemplo que refuta la conjetura de Hirsch|website=Gaussianos|date=May 24, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{citation|url=http://gilkalai.wordpress.com/2010/05/10/francisco-santos-disproves-the-hirsch-conjecture/|title=Francisco Santos Disproves the Hirsch Conjecture|last=Kalai|first=Gil|authorlink=Gil Kalai|accessdate=2015-07-18|work=Combinatorics and more|date=10 May 2010}}.</ref> In 2015 he won the [[Fulkerson Prize]] for this research.<ref name="2015 Fulkerson Prize citation">[http://www.mathopt.org/?nav=fulkerson_2015 2015 Fulkerson Prize citation], retrieved 2015-07-18.</ref>
[[File:santos francisco.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Santos in 2012]]

Santos was born in [[Valladolid]], Spain.<ref name="cv">[http://personales.unican.es/santosf/CVeng.pdf Curriculum vitae] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160416140851/http://personales.unican.es/santosf/CVeng.pdf |date=2016-04-16 }}, retrieved 2015-07-18.</ref> He earned a [[licenciate]] in mathematics from the University of Cantabria in 1991, and a master's degree in pure mathematics from [[Joseph Fourier University]] in [[Grenoble]], France in the same year.<ref name="cv"/> He returned to Cantabria for his doctorate, which he finished in 1995, with a thesis on the [[combinatorial geometry]] of [[algebraic curve]]s and [[Delaunay triangulation]]s supervised by Tomás Recio.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=37099}}</ref> He also has a second licenciate, in physics, from Cantabria in 1996. After postdoctoral studies at the [[University of Oxford]] he returned to Cantabria as a faculty member in 1997, and was promoted to full professor in 2008. From 2009 to 2013 he has been vice-dean of the Faculty of Sciences at Cantabria.<ref name="cv"/>

As well as being honored by the [[Fulkerson Prize]] in 2015 for a counter-example of the [[Hirsch conjecture]],<ref name="Santos 2011 383–412"/><ref name="2015 Fulkerson Prize citation"/> he was an invited sectional speaker at the 2006 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="cv"/>

Santos is an Editor-in-Chief of the [[Electronic Journal of Combinatorics]].<ref name=E-JC>{{cite web | url = http://www.combinatorics.org/ojs/index.php/eljc/about/editorialTeam | title = Editorial Team, Electronic Journal of Combinatorics | access-date = 24 July 2015}}</ref>
